newsitem.title: USA: Stirus sees distribution pact raising revs.
newsitem.headline: Stirus sees distribution pact raising revs.

text.p: Stirus Research & Development Inc said Thursday it signed a deal to distribute its hypodermic needle incinerator in France, which it expected to generate an additional $41.6 million in annual revenues.

Strirus said the agreement with European distributor ERA calls for the company to deliver a minimum of 52,000 needle incinerators per year, starting immediately. ERA will have the exclusive marketing and distribution rights in France.
Company officials were not immediately available to elaborate on the deal.
The company's stock closed at 8-12/16 August 5.
